data.name: PasswordMismatch
data.value: The two passwords are not the same.

data.name: PasswordUnchanged
data.value: The new password is the same as the current one.

data.name: UnlockCanceled
data.value: No password was given: nothing was done.

data.name: NoCompression
data.value: An encrypted disk cannot be compressed: qemu-img does not combine compression and encryption.

data.name: NeedsQcow2
data.value: This machine's disks are encrypted, and only qcow2 can be: another format would hold its data in clear.

data.name: WrongPassword
data.value: Wrong password: it does not open this machine's disks.

data.name: RememberedPasswordWrong
data.value: The remembered password no longer opens the disks (changed elsewhere?). Type the current one.

data.name: ImageLocked
data.value: This machine's disks are encrypted and its password has not been given.

data.name: WizardExistingDisk
data.value: An existing image is attached as it is. Create the machine, then encrypt its disks from its summary.

data.name: AlreadyEncrypted
data.value: The disks of this machine are already encrypted.

data.name: NotEncrypted
data.value: The disks of this machine are not encrypted.

data.name: NeedsQcow2Disks
data.value: Only qcow2 disks can be encrypted. Convert these to qcow2 first: {0}.

data.name: RefusedLinkedClone
data.value: This machine is a linked clone: it reads another machine's images, which must not change. Make it independent first (« Convert… » on its disks) or make a full copy.

data.name: RefusedHasLinkedClones
data.value: Linked clones read this machine's images, which must not change. Delete the clones or make them independent first.

data.name: NoSpace
data.value: Not enough free space: the copy needs about {0}, the drive has {1}.

data.name: AttachClearImage
data.value: This machine's disks are encrypted, and this image is not: the machine would write to it in clear. Attach an image encrypted with the machine's password, or decrypt the machine first.

data.name: AutoStartNeedsPassword
data.value: {0} was not started: its disks are encrypted and no password is remembered. Start it yourself to type it.

data.name: StatusRemembered
data.value: The password is remembered by Windows for your account.

data.name: StatusAsked
data.value: The password is asked at the first start after WinQEMU opens.

data.name: RememberHint
data.value: Remembered, the password is kept in the Windows Credential Manager, protected by your Windows session, and the machine can start with WinQEMU. Otherwise it stays in memory until WinQEMU closes.

data.name: PromptBody
data.value: The disks of {0} are encrypted. Type their password.

data.name: UnlockFailedTitle
data.value: The disks could not be unlocked

data.name: EncryptBody
DecryptBody
data.value: Each disk is copied into a new image in clear, which then replaces it. The snapshots are lost, it needs free space for a copy of each disk, and the remembered password is forgotten.

data.name: ChangeBody
data.value: Every image of the machine gets the new password; nothing is copied and the snapshots stay. It takes a few seconds per image.

data.name: ForgetBody
data.value: The password of {0} is removed from the Windows Credential Manager. It will be asked at the next start, and the machine will no longer start with WinQEMU by itself.

data.name: LeftInPlaceBody
data.value: These images are outside the machine's folder and were not deleted. The machine no longer uses them, but they hold its data as it was: {0}

data.name: SectionHint
data.value: As with VMware, the disks are encrypted with a password (LUKS, AES-256). The machine must be stopped to encrypt, decrypt or change the password.

data.name: WizardHint
data.value: LUKS, AES-256, qcow2 only. Without the password the data cannot be recovered. Starts ask for it unless it is remembered.

data.name: WizardNeedsQcow2
data.value: Only a qcow2 disk can be encrypted.

data.name: WizardSummaryRemembered
data.value: Encrypted disks, password remembered by Windows

data.name: WizardSummaryAsked
data.value: Encrypted disks, password asked at start

data.name: ExportInClear
data.value: The disks are encrypted here, but not in the package: VMware and VirtualBox cannot read QEMU's encryption, so the .ova holds their data in clear. Keep it somewhere safe.
